$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFEQ (AIP France, chart dated 2025-04-17): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Quiberon

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: AD prohibited for gliders and paramotors.
From 01/06 to 15/09, (except for State ACFT on a public mission), AD usable: on ARR: 0600-1900; on DEP: 0600-1030 and 1200-1800.
From 16/09 to 31/05: AD available SR-30 - SS+30.
AD likely to be covered by sea haze in few minutes.
QFU 292°: severe turbulence on short final in case of strong wind.
Area LF-R 13 and LF-R 14 from the coastline: caution with their activities.
No RWY inspection outside AFIS SKED Radio contact is mandatory according to the AFIS volume 3 NM / 2000 ft.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
TWY A1 and A2 only usable to vacate RWY.
TWY A reserved for ACFT whose main gear overall width is lower or equal to 5.10 m.
Unpaved PRKG available from May to September.
